title: Refundable Amount Paid to an Estate under an Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
**Refundable amount.** An estate refund under an **Entrance Fee Agreement** pays the refundable amount, which is the entrance fee received less every retention, amortization, processing fee, offset, refurbishment deduction and refund entered on the agreement's ledger, rounded to the cent half up, in one payment.

## Ledger lines

| Ledger entries of the agreement | Direction |
|---|---|
| Deposit payments and balance payments (the entrance fee received) | In |
| Administrative retention | Out |
| Amortization entries | Out |
| Processing fee | Out |
| Offsets against unpaid residency charges | Out |
| Refurbishment deductions | Out |
| Refund payments already entered | Out |

The refundable amount is the total in, less the total out, as the ledger stands at the payment.

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreement)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Entrance fee received | 340900.00 |
| Administrative retention | 13636.00 |
| Amortization entries in total | 120000.00 |
| Offsets against unpaid independent living charges | 3050.00 |
| Refurbishment deduction | 4000.00 |
| Refundable amount paid to the estate | 200214.00 |

The figure is paid to the estate in one payment.
